# Tomas Korcak

Software for evidence: AI agents that prove their work, honest instruments in the browser, knowledge you can check.

## Hire

Tomas Korcak is available for hire: Staff engineer for AI agent infrastructure, Elixir and Rust. https://korczis.github.io/hire/

- Staff or principal engineer: AI agent infrastructure, developer tooling, MCP
- Forward deployed or applied AI engineer: agentic workflows in production
- Backend and distributed systems: Elixir, OTP, Phoenix, Rust, PostgreSQL
- Fractional CTO and technical due diligence: data, OSINT, M&A
- Engagement: full-time, contract, fractional; remote, worldwide, working in the Central European time zone; available since 2026-11
- Contract rate: from USD 110 per hour, B2B; full-time compensation by conversation

## Services

What I offer: each service with its problem, method, deliverables, skills and evidence.

- [Corporate and counterparty due diligence](https://korczis.github.io/services/due-diligence/): Know who you are dealing with before you sign: one resolved entity, every source cross-checked, every red flag explained.
- [M&A pre-deal screening and analysis](https://korczis.github.io/services/m-and-a/): A fast, evidenced answer before the term sheet: go, or first ask for these documents.
- [Digital investigation and OSINT dossiers](https://korczis.github.io/services/digital-investigation/): A complete, sourced picture of a person, a company or a network, from open sources only.
- [Digital forensics and evidence preservation](https://korczis.github.io/services/digital-forensics/): Findings that hold up when someone challenges them.
- [Reputation intelligence and adverse-media monitoring](https://korczis.github.io/services/reputation-intelligence/): Know what is being said, how credible it is, and when the narrative shifts.
- [Sanctions, PEP and beneficial-ownership screening](https://korczis.github.io/services/compliance-screening/): Screening that neither drowns you in false positives nor quietly misses a true match.
- [Insolvency, litigation and register change monitoring](https://korczis.github.io/services/continuous-monitoring/): Learn about trouble at a counterparty the day it becomes public, not at the next annual review.
- [External attack surface and cyber-exposure assessment](https://korczis.github.io/services/attack-surface/): See your organisation, or an acquisition target, the way an attacker sees it.
- [Decision support and AI agents for analysts](https://korczis.github.io/services/decision-support-ai/): AI that makes analysts faster without taking their signature away.
- [Governed AI-assisted software delivery](https://korczis.github.io/services/ai-engineering-governance/): AI agents that write code under rules they cannot skip, with the evidence of every change kept.
- [Interactive data products and simulators](https://korczis.github.io/services/interactive-data-products/): Data and models people drive themselves, where every mark leads to its source.
